/bin/zsh -lc "./run_python - <<'PY'
import app

p = app.EventStream()
raw = '{\"event\":\"token\",\"text\":\"é\"}\\n{\"event\":\"done\"}\\n'.encode()
split = raw.index(b'\\xc3') + 1
assert p.feed(raw[:split]) == []
assert p.feed(raw[split:]) == [
    {\"event\": \"token\", \"text\": \"é\"},
    {\"event\": \"done\", \"text\": \"é\", \"characters\": 1, \"words\": 1},
]

p = app.EventStream()
try:
    p.feed(b'{\"event\":\"done\"}\\n{}\\n')
except app.StreamError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError(\"trailing bytes accepted\")

try:
    p.feed(b\"\")
except app.StreamError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError(\"failed parser reused\")

p = app.EventStream(max_buffer=1)
assert p.feed(b\"{}\\n\") == []
PY"
